item.title: Piggly Wiggly's Founder Bet $10 Million Against Wall Street
item.description:
In 1916 Clarence Saunders invented self-service grocery shopping. Years later he borrowed about $10 million to beat the traders betting against his stock. The price hit $124 by noon, then the stock exchange stopped trading and he went bankrupt.
Robbed, or pushed too far? 👇
#pigglywiggly #businesshistory

item.title: This Man Turned $3,000 of Pudding Into 1.2 Million Airline Miles
item.description:
In 1999, David Phillips noticed a Healthy Choice promo paid airline miles for barcodes, and pudding cost about 25 cents a cup. He bought 12,150 cups and earned more than 1.2 million miles.
Genius loophole or too far? 👇
#puddingguy #businesshistory

item.title: Disney Secretly Bought a Swamp Using Fake Names
item.description:
Walt Disney hid behind fake companies (one was called "M.T. Lott") to buy 27,000+ acres of Florida swamp for under $200 an acre, before a reporter cracked the secret in 1965.
Was it smart business or a dirty trick? 👇
#disney #businesshistory
